Missing references, unknown ownership or material uncertainty must remain unresolved; do not invent facts, conversions or applicability. The common caller declaration states the research population and selected editions, not certified real-vessel eligibility. Never request evaluation identities, labels, counterparts or reference solutions. Conditions within the represented requirement remain in scope. A successful execution-only probe does not establish regulatory correctness or full branch coverage.
